content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The National Bamboo Mission (NBM) is a scheme designed to reduce dependency on bamboo imports and enhance income of primary producers through improved productivity and suitability of domestic raw material for industry [E03]. The scheme targets to provide benefits to farmers, government agencies, artisans, entrepreneurs, private agencies, Federated SHGs, FPOs, and other persons involved in the bamboo industry [E03]. It assists in establishing bamboo nursery, bamboo cultivation, post-harvest processing, product manufacturing, capacity building, entrepreneurship, and other activities for the industry [E03]. The scheme is applicable to all farmers in India and does not require any specific qualifications, only land ownership with proper documentation [E03].","cited_evidence_ids":["E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"NBM aims to reduce dependency on bamboo imports and enhance income of primary producers","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"The scheme targets farmers, government agencies, artisans, entrepreneurs, private agencies, Federated SHGs, FPOs, and other persons involved in bamboo industry","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"NBM assists in establishing bamboo nursery, cultivation, post-harvest processing, product manufacturing, capacity building, and entrepreneurship","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"The scheme is applicable to all farmers in India with no qualifications required","evidence_ids":["E03"]}]}
